<b>Skarr Stalkers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are skilled [[Skarr]] hunters, wielding a bone blade and helmet.<ref>Skarr Stalker Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Skilled ant hunter bearing blade and armour fashioned from bone."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skarr Stalkers do not naturally wander and start off resting, letting out a battle cry once Hornet comes close and beginning their assault.<br>
They can walk forwards to close the distance between them and Hornet, and have a multitude of different attacks and manoeuvres:
* <b>Triple Slash:</b> Swings their blade three times, moving forward with each swing. They cancel the third swing if Hornet is behind them.
* <b>Dash Slash:</b> Raises their blade before dashing forward a long distance, finishing with a swing. The swing also hits slightly behind them.
* <b>Dive Slash:</b> Jumps in the air, before diving to the ground at a variable, but mainly diagonal angle, ending with an outwards swing once they hit the ground. The swing also hits slightly behind them. The angle they dive at is not static, and they readjust it to aim towards Hornet.
* <b>Block:</b> Enters a defensive stance using their blade. Any damage coming towards the front is negated, and the Skarr is pushed back. They may follow a blocked attack with any of the attacks above.
* <b>Backdash:</b> Performs a short dash backwards to get distance.
* <b>Burrow:</b> Burrows into the ground if Hornet leaves their platform, coming back up at their spawn position once Hornet gets near it.

Skarr Stalkers deal {{damage|1}} with all of their attacks and upon contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Skarr Stalkers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Skarr Stalkers are primarily found in [[Hunter's March]] and the [[Far Fields]], but they also appear in the upper [[Deep Docks]] and as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 4|gauntlet]] in [[Halfway Home]]'s cellar.

In Hunter's March, clearing the central [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Hunter's March 2|gauntlet]] allows one Skarr Stalker to spawn as a random encounter on subsequent visits before [[Act 3]]. In the Deep Docks, a Skarr Stalker near the [[Weaver Burial Spire]] starts to spawn only after the [[Drifter's Cloak]] is acquired.
